# Axovion.io
> ROI-focused AI automation agency building production-grade AI agents that automate customer support, lead follow-up, booking, and repetitive business workflows.

## About
Axovion bridges the gap between cutting-edge LLMs and high-reliability business operations. We engineer autonomous AI agents designed to operate unattended inside existing enterprise workflows, CRM platforms, and ticketing systems.

- **Website**: https://www.axovion.io
- **Founder**: Muneeb ur Rehman (Founder & AI Solutions Architect)
- **Co-Founder**: Muhammad Hamza Zafar (Co-Founder & Head of Automation)
- **Primary Offer**: Free 24-Hour AI Audit (https://www.axovion.io/audit)

## Core Services
1. **AI Customer Support Agents**: Autonomous tier-1 and tier-2 ticket resolution, intelligent triage, and CRM sync (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce).
2. **Lead Qualification & Autonomous Booking**: 24/7 instant lead triage, multi-channel response (email, SMS, WhatsApp), calendar booking directly into Hubspot / Calendly.
3. **Intelligent Workflow Automation**: Custom multi-agent integrations eliminating manual data entry, invoice processing, order reconciliation, and cross-platform handoffs.
4. **AI Audit & Readiness Assessment**: Comprehensive mapping of workflows with quantifiable monthly ROI calculations delivered in 24 hours.

## Key Outcomes & Metrics
- Up to 82% of repetitive support tickets resolved without human intervention.
- Sub-2 minute first-reply time across all digital touchpoints.
- Average payback period under 60 days on production agent deployments.
